concerns.text: Task T004b is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly states 'Depends on: T004' and 'This task is sequential'. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard dependency on a preceding task in the same phase. The [P] tag must be removed to prevent race conditions where checksumming runs before the file is fully written.

Task T005b is marked [P] but depends on T005 ('Depends on: T005'). Similarly, T006 is marked [P] but depends on T005. These tasks form a sequential data pipeline (Download -> Clean -> Tensorize -> Split). Marking them [P] implies they can run concurrently, which violates the producer-consumer dependency chain required for the data artifacts.

Task T012a (Featurize for RF) is marked [P] but depends on T005. Task T013 (RF Architecture) depends on T012a. Task T016 (RF Training) depends on T013 and T006. The [P] tag on T012a is incorrect as it cannot run until T005 completes. The [P] tag on T013 is also risky if T012a is not finished, as the architecture definition might need to align with the specific fingerprint output.

Task T021 (GNN Training) is marked [P] but depends on T005b (Graph Tensors) and T006 (Split). These are foundational data artifacts. While T021 can run in parallel with US1 tasks (T016), it cannot run in parallel with its own data producers (T005b, T006). The [P] tag is misleading in the context of the full phase dependencies.

Task T033 (Aggregation) is marked [P] but explicitly requires T016 and T021. It cannot run until both US1 and US2 training loops are complete. Marking it [P] suggests it can run in parallel with the training tasks, which is impossible as it consumes their output.

Task T046 (Final Report) is marked [P] but depends on T031 and T030. T031 depends on T032, which depends on T028 and T024. This is a strict sequential chain. Marking T046 [P] is a semantic violation of the dependency flow.
Task T047 (Artifact Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T045 (End-to-End Pipeline). T045 depends on ALL previous phases. T047 cannot run until T045 completes. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T048 (Edge Case Stress Test) is marked [P] but depends on T004 and T005. While it could theoretically run in parallel with US1/US2 implementation, it depends on the *completion* of T004/T005 logic. If T004/T005 are still being implemented (as implied by the [X] status vs. the 'Re-plan' note), T048 cannot run. More critically, T048 is a verification step that logically follows the implementation of the error handling in T004/T005, making the [P] tag semantically ambiguous without explicit 'after implementation' context.
